newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra unit sold 10,292 vehicles in July.
newsitem.headline: Astra unit sold 10,292 vehicles in July.

text.p: Indonesian automobile joint venture PT Toyota Astra Motor, a unit of PT Astra International and Japan's Toyota Motor, said it sold 10,292 passenger and commercial vehicles in July 1997 against 5,996 units in July 1996.
Toyota Astra said in a statement received on Wednesday the firm sold a total of 46,443 units in the first seven months of 1997, against 42,360 units in the same period of last year.
The statement said its best selling multi-purpose van, the Toyota Kijang, continued to be the largest contributor.
The firm sold 8,702 Kijangs in July against 4,701 in the same period last year.
The total number of Kijang units sold in the first seven months of this year was 37,351 units compared with 32,435 units in the same period last year, the statement said.
The statement did not give further details.
